text:
anya: Quick sync — status update on SOC2 milestones for KMS/HSM & audit logs. Post owners + top blockers and I'll consolidate into the tracker.

mike: KMS owner here. Working on key rotation playbook, PR open: #842. Blocker: staging HSM certs expired, need new vendor certs.

sophia: Audit logs: I'll take retention/ingest. Compliance leaning 365d for critical logs. Can we confirm scope?

kevin: HSM attestation owner. Vendor onboarding scheduled Tue. Need a service account with HSM/KMS access from infra. @lina can you grant?

lina: Granting account today. Also we need to pick forward format for audit logs — lean towards JSONL for indexing.

mike: Rotation playbook plan: weekly dry-run + automated alerting. PR link: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/842

audit-bot: New evidence bucket created: gs://redwood-audit/soc2/kms-rotations/

anya: Thanks. Please add checklist items to tracker doc: https://docs.redwood/soc2/track (I'll update owners there). Pinging @jessica for retention/legal signoff.

jessica: On it. Do we have sample evidence for key wrap operations? Need one for auditors.

sophia: I'll upload sample logs + manifests by EOD. Note: need to scrub PII from payloads before upload.

kevin: Blocker: HSM test harness failing in staging — getting 502 on attest. Example:
```
curl -v https://hsm-staging.internal/attest -d '{}'
# HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
```
Raising infra ticket #1234.

mike: :thumbsup: I'll try to repro locally. If infra-bot can trigger a new deploy that might clear the cache.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Starting deploy for hsm-staging (deploy id: d-9832).

lina: If deploy doesn't help we can fail over to backup region and continue onboarding.

anya: Summarizing owners: KMS = mike, Audit logs = sophia, HSM attestation = kevin, Infra = lina. Next checkpoints: evidence uploaded by sophia (EOD), HSM vendor onboarding token by Tue, rotation playbook merged by Fri. I'll update sprint board and ping again tomorrow.

mike: noted.

sophia: will upload.

kevin: will follow up on ticket.

lina: access granted.

jessica: will review evidence after upload.
